title: 16706 - 16706/P0322/000802
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Engine Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G28) loose
Engine Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G28) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Engine Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G28)
technicalNotes:
The Engine Speed Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G28) is also used as a reference sensor for the Krank Devir Sensörü.
Kontrol edin:  the wiring to/from the sensor and engine Kontrol Modülü to rule out harness and module damage due to engine oil or coolant from a failed sensor or tensioner. This is an example from a 2012 Tiguan with Coolant in the ECM which resulted in G28 DTCs in addition to intermittent stalling.
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
